axis_report: The frozen production diff implements the approved event-history slice. I independently compared all changed production hunks with the 13 criteria and the canonical initiative. I reconciled both bounded assessments rather than treating their verdicts as proof. Ticket summaries precede history. Explicit labels separate execution, review verdict and source identity. Dedicated details put readable content before evidence metadata. Stable event identity and retained pane offsets support return navigation and live updates. Invalid history remains inspectable without granting transition authority. I checked the loader validation/count boundary directly: individual invalid events remain visible, accepted receipts pass identity and parent-graph checks before totals become available, and freshness failures do not redefine recorded attempts. This resolves the main cross-slice distinction between receipt validity, source freshness and action safety. No documented blocker, contradictory behavior or unrelated feature expansion was identified. Source identity, clean worktree status and the exact production diff hash were freshly verified. Behavioral test and native observations below are prior evidence, not fresh execution by this reviewer. Fresh suite, compiler and native verification remain with the main reviewer. This Spec verdict does not authorize integration or ticket completion.
